name.ja: ハロプラ モモハロ

description.ja: 『ガンダムビルドダイバーズ』に登場するピンクカラーのハロが登場！
description.en: The pink-colored halo that appears in "Gundam Build Divers" is now available!

description.ja: • 愛らしい耳パーツがつき、一層キュートなシルエットになっており、耳パーツは可動して表情付けが可能！
description.en: • Adorable ear parts are included, making it an even cuter silhouette, and the ear parts can be moved to create different expressions!

description.ja: • 差し替え式で手足を出した状態も再現できるほか、ハロプラ用台座も付属！
description.en: • In addition to being interchangeable, you can also recreate the state with the arms and legs out, and a pedestal for Haropura is also included!
